+    _TTY_MACRO = re.compile(r'(?<!\w)(?P<name>[IBMUCLR])\((?P<content>[^)]+)\)|(?<!\w)HORIZONTALLINE(?!\w)')
+
+    @classmethod
+    def tty_ify(cls, text):
+        def replace(match):
+            name = match.group('name')
+            if name is None:
+                return '\n-------------\n'
+
+            content = match.group('content')
+            if name in ('L', 'R'):
+                label, separator, target = content.partition(',')
+                if not separator or not label or not target.strip():
+                    return match.group(0)
+                if name == 'L':
+                    return '%s <%s>' % (label, target.lstrip(' '))
+                return label
+
+            if name in ('I', 'C'):
+                return "`%s'" % content
+            if name == 'B':
+                return '*%s*' % content
+            if name == 'M':
+                return '[%s]' % content
+            return content  # U(url)
+
+        return cls._TTY_MACRO.sub(replace, text)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _fill_tty(text, width, **kwargs):
+        # textwrap.fill turns newlines into spaces, so wrap around horizontal rules.
+        sections = text.split('\n-------------\n')
+        if len(sections) == 1:
+            return textwrap.fill(text, width, **kwargs)
+
+        wrapped = [textwrap.fill(sections[0], width, **kwargs)]
+        continuation = dict(kwargs, initial_indent=kwargs.get('subsequent_indent', ''))
+        wrapped.extend(textwrap.fill(section, width, **continuation) for section in sections[1:])
+        return '\n-------------\n'.join(wrapped)
+

+# Copyright: (c) 2026, Ansible Project
+# GNU General Public License v3.0+ (see COPYING or https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt)
+
+from __future__ import (absolute_import, division, print_function)
+__metaclass__ = type
+
+import pytest
+
+from ansible import context
+from ansible.cli.doc import DocCLI
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('source, expected', [
+    ('I(important)', "`important'"),
+    ('B(bold)', '*bold*'),
+    ('M(module)', '[module]'),
+    ('U(https://example.com)', 'https://example.com'),
+    ('C(value)', "`value'"),
+    ('L(link text,https://example.com)', 'link text <https://example.com>'),
+    ('L(link text, https://example.com)', 'link text <https://example.com>'),
+    ('R(reference text,reference-id)', 'reference text'),
+    ('R(reference text, reference-id)', 'reference text'),
+    ('HORIZONTALLINE', '\n-------------\n'),
+])
+def test_tty_ify_macros(source, expected):
+    assert DocCLI.tty_ify(source) == expected
+
+
+def test_tty_ify_mixed_text():
+    source = 'Use M(name), B(text), C(value), and R(read more,ref). See L(site, https://example.com).'
+    expected = "Use [name], *text*, `value', and read more. See site <https://example.com>."
+    assert DocCLI.tty_ify(source) == expected
+
+
+def test_tty_ify_preserves_non_macros_and_words():
+    source = 'IBM(International Business Machines) wordM(name) X(value) L(missing reference) HORIZONTALLINES'
+    assert DocCLI.tty_ify(source) == source
+
+
+def test_man_text_keeps_horizontal_rules_when_wrapping(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(context, 'CLIARGS', {'type': 'module'})
+    monkeypatch.setattr(DocCLI, 'IGNORE', DocCLI.IGNORE)
+    doc = {
+        'module': 'example',
+        'filename': '/tmp/example.py',
+        'description': 'Before HORIZONTALLINE After',
+        'options': {'value': {'description': 'First HORIZONTALLINE Second'}},
+        'notes': ['Start HORIZONTALLINE End'],
+    }
+
+    output = DocCLI.get_man_text(doc)
+    assert output.count('\n-------------\n') == 3
+    assert 'HORIZONTALLINE' not in output
